function_question: How does nature hide in plain sight?

opening.text: There was a girl called Aria who belonged to a nature club that met by the park pond.
The club tried to film the shy birds that visit the pond, but the birds flew off whenever they spotted the camera.
Aria had an idea: "What if the birds couldn't see the camera at all? We need a cover that melts into the bushes!"

card.problem: Shy birds fly off from the camera
card.goal: A cover that blends into bushes

guide.brief: I'm Popi, your story guide. Aria's nature club needs a camera cover so good the birds never notice it. Can you help her hide it? Let's start!
guide.your_idea: Some engineers already have a spark of a camouflage idea. Do you?
guide.nature_clues: Nature has been playing hide-and-seek for millions of years. Tap each card to meet four masters of disguise!
guide.design_secret: Here's how eyes find things, and how the heroes fool them…
guide.skill: Scientists predict before they test. Which paper shape will take your friend longest to find?
guide.sketch: Time to draw your camera cover in its hiding place!
guide.build_and_test: Build your cover, hide it next to a plain box and ask 3 people to find each one. Time every search!
guide.retry_tip: Engineers never stop at round 1. Change ONE trick, colour, outline or shadow, and test again!
guide.ending: And ever since then, the nature club films the shy birds from YOUR hidden camera, and the birds never even notice it!

quick_check.question: Three friends spot the plain box in 2, 3 and 4 seconds. What is the average time?
quick_check.right: Right! Add them up to get 9, then share by 3 people. You'll use averages in the big test!
quick_check.wrong: Not quite. Add the three times, then divide by 3.

clue_cards.name: Cuttlefish
clue_cards.trick: It changes its skin colour and pattern in less than a second.
clue_cards.does: It matches the sand, rocks or seaweed around it and seems to vanish.

clue_cards.name: Stick insect
clue_cards.trick: It looks, and even moves, like a twig.
clue_cards.does: It sways gently as if the wind were blowing, so it passes for a twig.

clue_cards.name: Deer
clue_cards.trick: Like many fish, it is darker on top and paler underneath.
clue_cards.does: This cancels the shadow on its belly, so it looks flat and hard to see.

clue_cards.name: Zebra
clue_cards.trick: Bold black-and-white stripes cover its body.
clue_cards.does: The stripes break up each outline, so a moving herd is hard to pick apart.

predict.prompt: Easy to spot or hard to spot? Predict first!

items.label: A red ball on green grass
A leaf-patterned box in the bushes
A plain box with a dark shadow

predict.explain: Eyes find things by their outline, their shadow and colours that don't match. The patterned box matches the bushes and breaks up its outline, so it's hard to find.

lab.title: The hide-and-seek lab
lab.predict: Hide each shape in the same spot. Which one will take your friend longest to find?
options: Paper coloured to match the spot

tool.name: Mind map
tool.intro: You already know the centre, the branches and the twigs. Today you'll learn the last 2 pieces that make a mind map come alive.

parts.name: Pictures
parts.what: Add quick doodles or icons to your ideas.
parts.example: 🍕 Doodle a tiny tomato next to the toppings twig.
parts.starter: Next to the colour branch I'll doodle a tiny…

parts.name: Links
parts.what: Draw lines to join ideas on different branches.
parts.example: 🍕 Link "cheese" on toppings to "melty" on cooking.
parts.starter: I'll link the cuttlefish on colour to…

sketch_checklist: I drew my camera cover in its hiding place.
I labelled how I match the colours and break up the outline.
I showed how I hide the shadow.

test.measure: seconds to spot it (average of 3 people)
test.check_question: Test one trick at a time. Which trick helped most?

reflection.question: Which camouflage trick did your cover use most?
